Stremio addon compatibility: catalog-only addons can resolve metadata from compatible providers. Manifest resource types, ID prefixes and catalog extras are respected. Live TV keeps tv/channel IDs and EPG schedules. Subtitles support video hash, ID and size, with ID-only fallback. Fixed the iOS regression test that classified Stremio live TV as an episodic series. Existing player, Torrentio, TorBox, settings and signing are preserved.

Torriodb Live UI: Native, device-specific overlay panels can now be changed while the app runs, without shipping a fresh IPA for each label, layout, color, button, toggle or slider. Includes owner STOP SURFING, STOP PLAN and HOME controls rendered over the player. Remote status can verify whether a UI document was loaded. UI actions use a restricted native allowlist; no remote code evaluation.
Adaptive 30-second Live TV verification: Fix stalled ESPN2 by extending device receipt deadlines and restoring nine native-verified channels from durable Torriodb evidence. Restart resumes at the next untested channel instead of replaying the first thirteen. After qualifying passes, healthy channels keep cycling with failure pruning and GitHub workflow continuation. No ChatGPT hourly tasks.
